facts: Business: Tuart Line Electrical Pty Ltd, a Perth electrical contractor (a sparky business). The week is Monday 16 Nov to Sunday 22 Nov 2026.
Jobs completed this week: 71, up 2 on last week. Goal: 60 jobs finished a week. Status: On target. Best week in the last 12: 74.
New enquiries this week: 110, up 7 on last week. Goal: 90 new enquiries a week. Status: On target. Best week in the last 12: 122.
Median first reply this week: 1.8 hrs, down 0.5 hrs on last week. Goal: Half our customers hear back within 2 hours. Status: On target. Best week in the last 12: 1.6 hrs.
Quote win rate this week: 53%, up 13 pts on last week. Goal: Win nearly 1 in 2 quotes. Status: On target. This is the best week in the last 12.
Team utilisation this week: 83%, up 4 pts on last week. Goal: Busy, not burnt out: 70% to 82% of the day on the tools. Status: Watch. Best week in the last 12: 75%.
Callback rate this week: 7%, up 1 pt on last week. Goal: Fewer than 3 in 100 jobs come back. Status: Off target. Best week in the last 12: 2%.
Average job value this week: $600, down $18 on last week. Goal: $550 average job. Status: On target. Best week in the last 12: $667.
On-time arrival this week: 89%. Goal: On site within 30 minutes of the booked time, 85% of the time. Status: On target.
Actual vs estimated hours this week: +4%. Goal: Jobs finish within 5% of the estimate. Status: On target.
Last 12 weeks: 61% of enquiries got a first reply within 4 hrs (goal: 8 in 10 enquiries answered within 4 hours).
Last 12 weeks: quotes answered within 4 hrs won 51%; quotes answered later won 19%.
Last 12 weeks: median first reply on Mondays 3.0 hrs, against 1.3 hrs Tuesday to Friday.
Last 12 weeks: 79% of weekday enquiries arriving after 3pm waited over 4 hrs for a reply, against 9% of those arriving 7am to 3pm.
Last 12 weeks: quote turnaround averaged 3.6 days (goal: Quotes out within 3 days).
Last 12 weeks: quote value won $158K, lost $231K.
Last 12 weeks, quote win rate by source: highest Referral at 54%, lowest Lead site at 23%.
Last 12 weeks, quote win rate by job type: highest Fault finding at 60%, lowest Smoke alarms at 29%.
Last 12 weeks, why quotes were lost: No reply from customer 90, Price 81, Went with another electrician 63, Job postponed or cancelled 34, We were too slow to get back 26.
Last 12 weeks, actual vs estimated hours: Switchboard upgrade +25%, Fault finding +10% (the job types furthest over estimate).
